title: Dior Beauty Has A Gingerbread-Themed Christmas Display And Pop-Up Cafe At Marina Bay Sands Singapore - FZINE Singapore
text:
Dior Beauty Has A Gingerbread-Themed Christmas Display And Pop-Up Cafe At Marina Bay Sands Singapore | FZINE Singapore FASHION CULTURE BEAUTY WATCHES AND JEWELLERY PEOPLE CAM PARTIES Beauty Enter Dior’s Enchanting Gingerbread Wonderland At Marina Bay Sands This Christmas Season
 Dior is spreading the holiday cheer with their dessert-themed display and special cafe collaboration in Singapore.
 Dior By  Paige Boon Xuanyi ,  17 Nov 2026 
 Get right into the Christmas magic with the Dior Sweet Atelier of Dreams display at Marina Bay Sands . Located at the centre of the Grande Colonnade South at The Shoppes, the space has been transformed into a whimsical, gingerbread-themed wonderland, complementing the sweet treat-inspired Dior Beauty Holiday collection .
 At first glance, you’ll immediately notice the spectacular nine-metre Christmas tree that stretches towards the glass canopy ceiling. This centrepiece of the installation is made out of tiers of Dior gift boxes, reimagined in gold with icing details and adorned with the House’s iconic medallion, just like the limited-edition from this year’s holiday makeup collection. Naturally, the Dior star, Christian Dior’s lucky charm, shines at the centre of the tree, adding an extra touch of festive sparkle. 
 Dior Right next to the golden Christmas tree is a gingerbread replica of Dior’s legendary 30 Montaigne flagship headquarters in Paris. Its glowing windows, featuring miniature J’adore and Miss Dior perfume bottles, add a charming touch to the facade. From there, a winding railway track emerges, looping around a larger-than-life tiered cake topped with an oversized gingerbread Miss Dior perfume bottle.
 Dior The magic doesn’t stop here. Look up and you’ll spot an enchanting light installation stretching across the glass canopy. The railway track appears to float overhead, weaving its way through brightly lit Christmas trees, candy canes, and Dior-related motifs. 
 As if the decorations aren’t breathtaking enough, things go up a notch with a special light show, held three times each night. Dazzling illuminations sweep across the main display and overhead fixture, bringing the gingerbread wonderland to life with music and special sequences.
 Dior Dior pop-up cafe in Singapore
 Dior Beyond the festive installation, Dior is spreading the joy of Christmas through their collaboration with Origin + Bloom cafe. Following the gingerbread theme, the limited-time pop-up features gingerbread cookies in the shapes of iconic Dior motifs like the Dior Medallion, Dior Star, and Miss Dior perfume bottle. Savoury pastries, mini cakes, and festive drinks are available for takeaway.
 Dior Christmas activations at Marina Bay sands: dates and timings to note
 The Dior Beauty Christmas installation will be on display until December 30, daily from 10am to 10pm. The light show occurs thrice daily until December 26, at 7.30pm, 8.30pm, and 9.15pm. 
 Meanwhile, the Dior Beauty x Origin + Bloom collaboration is available at Level 1 of the Marina Bay Sands Expo and Convention Centre until December 30, open daily from 11am to 8.30pm.
